titulo: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
resumo_original: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.

titulo: Citizen Lab says governments are abusing online ads to hack people with ‘zero-click’ spyware
resumo_original: The digital rights unit found evidence that dozens of devices at media organization Al Jazeera were hacked after being shown malicious online ads.

titulo: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
resumo_original: Figma is also releasing its code layers feature in open beta.

titulo: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
resumo_original: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.

titulo: Flock CEO defends surveillance technology amid national backlash: ‘We shouldn’t pause progress’
resumo_original: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended his company's surveillance technology despite growing privacy concerns, arguing that its crime-fighting benefits outweigh the risks of abuse.

titulo: Fridge hack costing millions and sparking fires stemmed from poor security
resumo_original: Incident hitting 700 supermarkets exploited outdated devices exposed to the Internet.

titulo: Epic says its new vibe-coded Epic Games Launcher is faster than Steam
resumo_original: But the new "Preview" app "will have some bugs," Epic warns.

titulo: NATO may redeploy anti-drone defenses as attacks sink more Black Sea shipping
resumo_original: Suspected Russian drones have sunk or damaged 5 ships near Bulgaria and Romania.
